title: Philadelphia-Style Strawberry Ice Cream (No Egg)
summary: An egg-free cream base churned with sweet macerated strawberry purée and finished with small pieces of fresh berry.

ingredients.item: light corn syrup or glucose syrup
fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Make the base
steps.text: Warm the cream, milk, sugar, corn syrup and salt in the saucepan, stirring, just until it reaches a simmer and the sugar has dissolved. Pour into the jug, cool, then chill for at least 4 h. The corn syrup keeps the ice cream soft enough to scoop.

steps.title: Macerate the berries
steps.text: Slice the strawberries into the bowl, toss with the 50 g sugar and the lemon juice and leave for 30 min until they release plenty of juice.

steps.title: Purée
steps.text: Lift out about a quarter of the berries and chop them into small pieces. Blend the rest with all the juice until smooth, then chill both.

steps.title: Combine
steps.text: Stir the purée into the cold cream base until evenly pink.

steps.title: Churn
steps.text: Churn for 20-30 min until thick like soft serve. Add the chopped strawberries in the last minute so they stay in pieces.

steps.title: Freeze and serve
steps.text: Pack into the container, cover the surface with baking paper and freeze for at least 4 h. Leave for 10 min before scooping, and serve with a halved strawberry.

tips: Use the ripest, most fragrant strawberries you can find; flavour matters more than size.
Keep the fruit pieces small, or they freeze icy.
Swap in raspberries or peaches using the same weight of fruit.
storage: Keep frozen in a covered container for up to 1 week; the fruit pieces turn icy after that.
